name: Microwave Moong Dal Khichdi
ingredients: ¼ cup basmati or brown rice, rinsed
½ cup (100 g) split yellow moong dal, rinsed
1 small carrot, diced, and ¼ cup peas
steps: In a large microwave-safe bowl (at least 2 litres), mix the oil, cumin and ginger. Microwave uncovered on high for 1 minute.
Add the rice, dal, vegetables, turmeric, salt and hot water. Stir.
Cover loosely with a plate or vented lid. Microwave on high for 6 minutes, then on medium (50%) for 12–14 minutes until soft.
Stand covered for 5 minutes, then stir well and add hot water if too thick.
note: Use a large bowl: khichdi bubbles up as it cooks.
